title: Enhanced Magnon Synchronization in Coupled WGM Optomagnonic Resonators with Phase-Dependent Photon Hopping
summary: We investigate quantum synchronization in a coupled cavity optomagnonic system which consists of two spatially separated optical whispering-gallery-mode (WGM) resonators and each resonator is also coupled to a yttrium iron garnet (YIG) sphere through the optomagnonic interaction. Phase-dependent single-photon hopping factor couples the two optical resonators and provides an indirect interaction between the two distant magnon modes.
